title.en: Single Phase Induction Motors
1.1 Need and correct classification of single-phase motors
title.gu: 1.1 Single-phase Motorsની જરૂર તથા સાચું વર્ગીકરણ

h.en: Need and correct classification of single-phase motors
h.gu: Single-phase Motorsની જરૂર તથા સાચું વર્ગીકરણ

body.en:
Definition

A single-phase induction motor is an asynchronous AC motor whose main stator winding is supplied from one phase and whose rotor current is induced by electromagnetic action rather than supplied through a commutator.

Classification / scope

  • Induction family:split-phase,resistance-start,capacitor-start induction-run,permanent-capacitor/capacitor-run,capacitor-start capacitor-run and shaded-pole.
  • Related syllabus machines:repulsion type,universal series motor and reluctance-based arrangements.These must be identified by their actual construction and operating principle.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • One-phase supply is widely available in homes and small premises;fans,pumps and appliances therefore need motors suited to this supply.The choice still depends on starting torque,duty,noise,efficiency and servicing.
  • A motor is not classified only by its supply.Universal and repulsion motors use commutators;their torque mechanism differs from the ordinary cage induction motor even though the syllabus groups them together.

Read each definition first,then identify the machine family and stated model assumptions.Do not transfer a formula across incompatible connections or sign conventions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Single-phase induction motor એવી asynchronous AC motor છે જેના main stator windingને એક phaseનો supply મળે અને rotorમાં current electromagnetic inductionથી ઉત્પન્ન થાય,commutatorથી અપાતો નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Induction family:split-phase,resistance-start,capacitor-start induction-run,permanent-capacitor/capacitor-run,capacitor-start capacitor-run તથા shaded-pole.
  • સંબંધિત syllabus machines:repulsion type,universal series motor તથા reluctance-based arrangements.તેમને actual construction/principle પ્રમાણે ઓળખવા.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • ઘર/નાનાં સ્થળે one-phase supply ઉપલબ્ધ હોવાથી fans,pumps/appliances માટે આવા motors જોઈએ.પસંદગી starting torque,duty,noise,efficiency/servicing પર પણ આધારિત છે.
  • માત્ર supply પરથી motorનો પ્રકાર નક્કી થતો નથી.Universal/repulsion motorsમાં commutator છે;syllabusમાં સાથે હોવા છતાં તેમનો torque mechanism ordinary cage induction motorથી જુદો છે.

પહેલાં વ્યાખ્યા વાંચી machine family તથા modelની ધારણાઓ ઓળખો.જુદાં connections/sign conventionsમાં formula અંધ રીતે નલગાડો.

title.en: 1.2 Double-field revolving theory and zero starting torque
title.gu: 1.2 Double-field Revolving Theory તથા Zero Starting Torque

h.en: Double-field revolving theory and zero starting torque
h.gu: Double-field Revolving Theory તથા Zero Starting Torque

body.en:
Definition

Double-field revolving theory resolves a sinusoidal pulsating air-gap field into two equal constant-amplitude fields rotating in opposite directions at synchronous speed.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • The theory explains the main-winding-only induction motor under ideal sinusoidal assumptions.At standstill both relative speeds and rotor impedances are equal,so opposing torques cancel.
  • Once a starting arrangement establishes direction,the forward/backward slips differ.The forward torque exceeds backward torque over the useful motoring region,so nonzero running torque is possible.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Let the pulsating space field be B(θ,t)=Bm cosθ cosωt;θ is electrical space angle and ω is electrical angular frequency.
  2. Using cosA cosB=[cos(A−B)+cos(A+B)]/2 gives B=(Bm/2)cos(θ−ωt)+(Bm/2)cos(θ+ωt).Each revolving component has half the peak pulsating amplitude.
  3. For forward rotor speed N,define s=(Ns−N)/Ns.Then sf=s and sb=(Ns+N)/Ns=2−s.
  4. At N=0,sf=sb=1 and Tnet=Tf−Tb=0.This is zero starting torque,not zero stator current or zero heating.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. For50 Hz,4poles,Ns=1500 rpm.At N=1440 rpm,sf=0.04and sb=1.96;the backward field remains and contributes opposing torque/loss.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Double-field revolving theory sinusoidal pulsating air-gap fieldને synchronous speedથી વિરુદ્ધ દિશામાં ફરતા સમાન amplitudeનાં બે fieldsમાં વિભાજિત કરે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Ideal sinusoidal ધારણામાં theory main-winding-only motor સમજાવે છે.Standstill પર relative speeds/rotor impedances સમાન હોવાથી બંને torque cancel થાય છે.
  • Starting arrangement દિશા આપે પછી forward/backward slips જુદા પડે છે.Useful motoring regionમાં forward torque વધુ હોવાથી net running torque મળે છે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Pulsating field B(θ,t)=Bm cosθ cosωt લો;θ electrical space angle તથા ω electrical angular frequency છે.
  2. cosA cosB=[cos(A−B)+cos(A+B)]/2 identityથી B=(Bm/2)cos(θ−ωt)+(Bm/2)cos(θ+ωt) મળે.દરેક revolving componentનું amplitude pulsating peakનું અડધું છે.
  3. Forward rotor speed N માટે s=(Ns−N)/Ns લો.પછી sf=s તથા sb=(Ns+N)/Ns=2−s થાય.
  4. N=0 પર sf=sb=1 અને Tnet=Tf−Tb=0.આ zero starting torque છે,zero stator current/heating નહીં.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. 50 Hz,4polesમાં Ns=1500 rpm.N=1440 rpm હોય તો sf=0.04/sb=1.96;backward field રહે છે અને opposing torque/loss આપે છે.

title.en: 1.3 How phase splitting produces a start
title.gu: 1.3 Phase Splittingથી Starting કેવી રીતે થાય?

h.en: How phase splitting produces a start
h.gu: Phase Splittingથી Starting કેવી રીતે થાય?

body.en:
Definition

Phase splitting produces a time displacement between currents in spatially displaced stator windings,creating an initial rotating-field component and a preferred torque direction.

Classification / scope

  • Resistance splitting,capacitor splitting and shaded-pole flux shifting are different starting approaches;their torque/efficiency/noise are not equal.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Main and auxiliary windings are commonly displaced by about90electrical degrees;their current phase difference α depends on resistance,reactance and any series capacitor.
  • Starting torque is approximately proportional to Im Ia sinα for a stated design.Auxiliary current alone is not sufficient:both spatial displacement and current phase difference matter.
  • Reverse only one winding relative to the other when the manufacturer exposes suitable terminals.Reversing both windings or swapping the two supply wires does not reverse their relative phase sequence.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Phase splittingમાં spatially displaced stator windingsના currents વચ્ચે time displacement બનાવી initial rotating-field component તથા preferred torque direction ઉત્પન્ન કરાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Resistance splitting,capacitor splitting તથા shaded-pole flux shifting જુદા starting approaches છે;torque/efficiency/noise સમાન નથી.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Main/auxiliary windings સામાન્ય રીતે આશરે90electrical degrees અલગ હોય છે;current phase difference α resistance,reactance/series capacitor પર આધારિત છે.
  • Stated designમાં starting torque આશરે Im Ia sinα પ્રમાણે છે.માત્ર auxiliary current પૂરતો નથી;spatial displacement તથા phase difference બંને જોઈએ.
  • Manufacturer યોગ્ય terminals આપે ત્યારે એક જ windingનું relative connection reverse કરો.બંને windings અથવા માત્ર supply wires બદલવાથી relative phase sequence બદલાતું નથી.

h.en: Reluctance starting:what it does and does not mean

body.en:
Definition

Reluctance torque is the torque tending to align a magnetically anisotropic rotor along a minimum-reluctance magnetic path;it is not proof that an ordinary single-phase induction motor is inherently self-starting.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • A reluctance-start/run arrangement may use an auxiliary winding or cage action for acceleration and rotor saliency for reluctance locking near synchronous speed.Read the actual motor construction before describing its start.
  • For an ideal reluctance synchronous machine,the torque depends on rotor saliency and load angle.It differs from the induction running torque that requires nonzero slip.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Reluctance torque magnetically anisotropic rotorને minimum-reluctance magnetic path સાથે align કરતું torque છે;તે ordinary single-phase induction motor self-starting છે એવો પુરાવો નથી.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Reluctance arrangementમાં acceleration માટે auxiliary winding/cage action અને synchronous speed પાસે locking માટે rotor saliency હોઈ શકે.Actual construction જોઈને starting સમજાવો.
  • Ideal reluctance synchronous machineમાં torque rotor saliency/load angle પર આધારિત છે.Nonzero slip માગતા induction running torqueથી તે જુદું છે.

h.en: Resistance split-phase starting:why winding design matters
h.gu: Resistance Split-phase Startingમાં Winding Designનું મહત્વ

body.en:
Definition

A resistance split-phase motor uses an auxiliary winding with a different resistance-to-reactance ratio from the main winding to obtain a starting current-phase displacement without relying on a start capacitor.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Main winding is designed with a relatively inductive current characteristic;the auxiliary branch has a higher effective resistance/reactance ratio.
  2. A start switch or approved electronic relay connects the auxiliary branch during starting and removes it at the designed operating condition.
  3. The ordinary cage rotor,laminated stator,bearings and protection complete the motor;winding resistance values are design-specific,not universal identification rules.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. At rest both branches are energised through their rated paths and carry phase-displaced currents.
  2. The resulting starting torque accelerates the load if it exceeds the required torque plus losses.
  3. The auxiliary branch is disconnected when the specified switch condition is met;main-winding induction action maintains running torque at slip.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • The auxiliary current normally lags the supply less than the more inductive main current.The two displaced winding axes therefore produce an imperfect rotating field and moderate starting torque.
  • The phase displacement is usually less than the ideal90°needed for a balanced two-phase field;therefore resistance splitting must not be described as automatically producing a perfect circular field.
  • The start winding and switch have limited thermal duty.Repeated failed starts can overheat the auxiliary branch even before the shaft delivers useful output.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Resistance split-phase motorમાં start capacitor વિના starting current-phase displacement માટે auxiliary windingનું resistance/reactance ratio main windingથી જુદું રાખાય છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Main windingનું current characteristic વધુ inductive;auxiliary branchનું effective resistance/reactance ratio વધારે હોય.
  2. Start switch/approved electronic relay startingમાં auxiliary branch જોડે/designed condition પર દૂર કરે.
  3. Cage rotor,laminated stator,bearings/protection motor પૂર્ણ કરે;winding resistance values design-specific છે,universal identification rule નહીં.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Rest પર બંને rated branches energise થઈ phase-displaced currents વહે.
  2. Required torque/lossesથી વધુ starting torque હોય તો load accelerate થાય.
  3. Specified condition પર auxiliary disconnect થાય;main-winding induction action slip પર running torque જાળવે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Auxiliary current સામાન્ય વધુ inductive main current કરતાં supplyને ઓછો lag કરે;બે displaced axesથી imperfect rotating field/moderate starting torque મળે.
  • Phase displacement સામાન્ય balanced two-phase માટેના ideal90°થી ઓછો છે;તેથી perfect circular field આપમેળે મળે એવું નકહો.
  • Start winding/switch limited thermal duty ધરાવે;repeated failed startsથી useful output પહેલાં જ auxiliary branch overheat થઈ શકે.

title.en: 1.4 Cage motor construction and energy conversion
title.gu: 1.4 Cage Motorનું Construction તથા Energy Conversion

h.en: Cage motor construction and energy conversion
h.gu: Cage Motorનું Construction તથા Energy Conversion

body.en:
Definition

The cage rotor is a laminated magnetic rotor containing conducting bars short-circuited by end rings,so induced currents can produce torque without rotor brushes.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Laminated stator core carries main/auxiliary insulated windings;lamination reduces eddy-current loss.
  2. Rotor bars/end rings form closed electrical paths;rotor laminations carry flux with reduced core loss.
  3. Air gap permits rotation while coupling flux;unwanted eccentricity increases magnetic pull/noise.
  4. Shaft,bearings,end shields and fan support alignment,load transmission and cooling;terminal box/protection isolate live parts.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Apply rated supply through the correct protected starting circuit;main/auxiliary currents establish starting torque.
  2. Rotor accelerates while electromagnetic torque exceeds load torque plus losses;the start device switches only when its designed condition is met.
  3. Operating speed settles at the torque-balance intersection;increasing load normally raises slip and heating,not synchronous speed.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Electrical input creates stator flux;relative field/rotor motion induces rotor EMF,current and force.The shaft receives developed mechanical power only after rotor copper loss;bearings/fan consume additional power.
  • At normal induction operation N<Ns.A rotor at synchronous speed relative to the forward field has no forward induced EMF in the ideal model;single-phase backward-field effects must not be ignored in detailed performance.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Cage rotor laminated magnetic rotor છે જેમાં conducting bars end ringsથી short-circuit થયાં છે;brushes વિના induced currentથી torque બને છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Laminated stator coreમાં insulated main/auxiliary windings છે;lamination eddy-current loss ઘટાડે છે.
  2. Rotor bars/end rings closed current paths બનાવે;laminations flux વહન કરીને core loss ઘટાડે.
  3. Air gap rotation/flux coupling આપે;eccentricityથી magnetic pull/noise વધે.
  4. Shaft,bearings,end shields/fan alignment,load transmission/cooling આપે;terminal box/protection live parts અલગ રાખે.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Correct protected starting circuitથી rated supply આપતાં main/auxiliary currents starting torque આપે.
  2. Electromagnetic torque load/lossesથી વધુ હોય ત્યાં rotor accelerate કરે;designed condition મળતાં જ start device switch થાય.
  3. Torque-balance intersection પર speed settle થાય;વધતા loadથી સામાન્ય રીતે slip/heating વધે,synchronous speed નહીં.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Electrical inputથી stator flux બને;relative motionથી rotor EMF/current/force મળે.Rotor copper loss બાદ developed mechanical power મળે;bearings/fan પણ power લે છે.
  • Normal induction operationમાં N<Ns.Ideal forward field પ્રમાણે synchronous rotorમાં forward induced EMF નથી;detailed single-phase performanceમાં backward field અવગણવો નહીં.

h.en: Torque–speed curve and stable operating point
h.gu: Torque–Speed Curve તથા Stable Operating Point

body.en:
Definition

A torque–speed characteristic relates the available electromagnetic torque to rotor speed at stated supply,frequency and starting-circuit condition.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Plot motor torque and load torque on the same axes.Acceleration occurs where Tmotor>Tload+Tloss;steady operation requires equality.
  • A stable intersection restores speed after a small disturbance;the local slope of accelerating torque with speed must be negative.The main-winding-only curve has zero net starting torque.
  • Adding a capacitor/auxiliary winding changes the starting curve;centrifugal switching creates a change of circuit,not an unexplained discontinuity to be copied without labels.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Torque–speed characteristic stated supply,frequency/starting circuit માટે rotor speed સાથે ઉપલબ્ધ electromagnetic torqueનો સંબંધ બતાવે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • સમાન axes પર motor/load torque દોરો.Tmotor>Tload+Tloss હોય ત્યાં acceleration;steady operationમાં equality જોઈએ.
  • Stable intersection disturbance બાદ speed restore કરે;accelerating torqueનો local speed-slope negative હોવો જોઈએ.Main-winding-only curveમાં net starting torque zero છે.
  • Capacitor/auxiliary windingથી starting curve બદલાય;centrifugal switching circuit બદલે છે,તેથી curve changeને label કરવું જોઈએ.

title.en: 1.5 Capacitor-start induction-run motor

h.en: Capacitor-start induction-run motor

body.en:
Definition

A capacitor-start induction-run motor uses a series capacitor in its auxiliary starting winding to obtain starting torque and disconnects that starting branch after acceleration.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Main winding is connected for running;auxiliary winding is spatially displaced.
  2. Start capacitor and centrifugal/electronic switch are in series with the auxiliary branch.
  3. Cage rotor,shaft,bearings and enclosure are the induction-machine mechanical parts.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. At rest the starting switch is closed,so both windings carry differently phased currents.
  2. Positive starting torque accelerates the rotor;near its specified changeover speed the switch opens.
  3. The motor continues on the main winding;the start capacitor must not remain energised because of a stuck switch.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • The capacitor increases the phase displacement between starting and main currents,improving starting torque.The capacitor and switch have intermittent-start ratings,not continuous-run permission.
  • Useful for suitable pumps/compressors requiring more starting torque;actual selection requires load inertia,starts per hour and manufacturer torque data.

Reliability checks and limitations

  • A changeover near70–80%of synchronous speed is a common illustration,not a universal setting.Diagnose a faulty switch only after isolation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Capacitor-start induction-run motor auxiliary starting windingમાં series capacitorથી starting torque મેળવે અને acceleration પછી starting branch disconnect કરે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Main winding running માટે જોડાય;auxiliary winding spatially displaced છે.
  2. Start capacitor/centrifugal અથવા electronic switch auxiliary branchમાં series છે.
  3. Cage rotor,shaft,bearings/enclosure induction machineના mechanical parts છે.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Rest પર starting switch closed હોવાથી બંને windingsમાં જુદા phaseનાં currents વહે છે.
  2. Positive starting torqueથી rotor accelerate થાય;specified changeover speed પાસે switch opens.
  3. Main windingથી motor ચાલે;stuck switchને કારણે start capacitor energised રહેવા નદેવો.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Capacitor main/start currentsનો phase displacement વધારી starting torque સુધારે.Capacitor/switch intermittent-start rated છે,continuous run માટે નહીં.
  • વધુ starting torque માગતા યોગ્ય pumps/compressorsમાં ઉપયોગી;load inertia,starts/hour/manufacturer torque data પણ તપાસવા.

વિશ્વસનીયતા માટે ચકાસણી તથા મર્યાદા

  • Synchronous speedના70–80% પાસે changeover સામાન્ય illustration છે,universal setting નહીં.Switch fault isolation પછી જ તપાસો.

h.en: Capacitor-start capacitor-run and permanent-capacitor motors

body.en:
Definition

A capacitor-start capacitor-run motor retains a continuous-duty run capacitor with its auxiliary winding and adds a larger effective starting capacitance only during acceleration.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Run capacitor is a manufacturer-specified AC continuous-duty component in the auxiliary branch.
  2. Additional start capacitor is switched for starting only;its connection commonly increases effective capacitance in parallel with the run capacitor.
  3. Windings,protection and switch/capacitor ratings must match the actual diagram;capacitance alone does not establish interchangeability.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Both capacitive contributions assist the initial phase split and acceleration.
  2. The start switch removes the extra capacitor at the designed speed while leaving the run branch connected.
  3. Main/auxiliary windings continue to carry phase-displaced currents in normal running.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • A permanent-capacitor motor has only the continuous run-capacitor branch;it avoids a centrifugal start switch but does not automatically provide high breakaway torque.
  • Continuous auxiliary excitation can improve running field balance,power factor and smoothness relative to a comparable main-winding-only run arrangement;actual efficiency is a measured/rated property.

Reliability checks and limitations

  • Ceiling fans often use permanent-capacitor designs,not necessarily capacitor-start capacitor-run designs.Confirm the model before naming it.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Capacitor-start capacitor-run motor auxiliary winding સાથે continuous-duty run capacitor રાખે અને માત્ર acceleration દરમિયાન વધુ effective starting capacitance ઉમેરે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Run capacitor auxiliary branchમાં manufacturer-specified AC continuous-duty component છે.
  2. Additional start capacitor માત્ર starting માટે switch થાય;સામાન્ય parallel connectionથી effective capacitance વધે.
  3. Windings,protection/switch-capacitor ratings actual diagram સાથે match કરવાના;માત્ર capacitanceથી interchangeability નક્કી નથી થતી.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. બંને capacitive contributions initial phase split/accelerationમાં મદદ કરે.
  2. Designed speed પર switch extra capacitor દૂર કરે,run branch જોડેલી રહે.
  3. Normal runningમાં main/auxiliary windings phase-displaced currents વહન કરે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Permanent-capacitor motorમાં માત્ર continuous run-capacitor branch હોય છે;centrifugal switch ટળે,પણ high breakaway torque આપમેળે મળતું નથી.
  • Continuous auxiliary excitationથી comparable main-only arrangement કરતાં field balance,power factor/smoothness સુધરી શકે;actual efficiency measured/rated property છે.

વિશ્વસનીયતા માટે ચકાસણી તથા મર્યાદા

  • Ceiling fansમાં ઘણીવાર permanent-capacitor design હોય છે,જરૂરી નથી કે CSCR હોય.Model જોઈને નામ આપો.

h.en: Shaded-pole motor

body.en:
Definition

A shaded-pole motor is a small single-phase induction motor in which a short-circuited shading turn around part of each stator pole delays the local flux and creates weak starting-field motion across the pole face.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Salient laminated poles carry the main excitation winding;each has an unshaded region and a copper shading loop around another region.
  2. A cage rotor and short air gap provide the induced-current torque path.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Changing main flux induces shading-loop current opposing its change,so shaded-region flux lags.
  2. The spatial/time-displaced flux pattern gives weak starting torque;normal running remains induction operation with slip.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • The apparent field sweeps from the unshaded toward the shaded part,setting the usual starting direction;the shading ring is not a series supply winding.
  • Low starting torque,low efficiency and simple low-cost construction suit small fans/blowers,not heavy-start compressors.

Reliability checks and limitations

  • Direction is usually fixed by pole construction;do not describe swapping supply leads as a reversal method.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Shaded-pole motor નાની single-phase induction motor છે જેમાં stator poleના ભાગ પર short-circuited shading turn local fluxને delay કરીને pole face પર નબળી starting-field motion બનાવે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Salient laminated poles પર main winding હોય;દરેકમાં unshaded region તથા બીજા ભાગે copper shading loop છે.
  2. Cage rotor/short air gap induced-current torqueનો માર્ગ આપે.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. બદલાતું main flux shading-loopમાં changeનો વિરોધ કરતો current induce કરે,એટલે shaded flux lag થાય.
  2. Spatial/time-displaced fluxથી weak starting torque મળે;running slipવાળું induction operation રહે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Apparent field unshadedથી shaded ભાગ તરફ sweep થાય અને સામાન્ય starting direction નક્કી કરે;shading ring supplyની series winding નથી.
  • Low starting torque/efficiency તથા સરળ ઓછા ખર્ચનું construction નાના fans/blowers માટે યોગ્ય,heavy-start compressor માટે નહીં.

વિશ્વસનીયતા માટે ચકાસણી તથા મર્યાદા

  • Direction સામાન્ય રીતે pole constructionથી fixed છે;supply leads swapથી reversal નકહો.

h.en: Repulsion-type motor

body.en:
Definition

A repulsion motor is a single-phase commutator AC motor with an energised stator and a wound rotor whose brushes are short-circuited and displaced from the stator magnetic axis to obtain torque.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Stator main winding creates alternating flux;laminated wound rotor has a commutator.
  2. Shorted brush gear has a defined angular displacement;mechanical alignment/protection remain essential.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Stator flux induces rotor current through the shorted brush/commutator circuit.
  2. Displaced rotor/stator magnetic axes interact to develop starting torque;special switching,if present,changes the running mode.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Rotor current is induced rather than supplied directly through the brushes;brush-axis displacement establishes the magnetic interaction producing starting torque.
  • Repulsion-induction and repulsion-start induction-run variants differ in how the running circuit is arranged.Do not claim every repulsion motor keeps identical brush action at running speed.
  • Brush/commutator wear,sparking and maintenance distinguish this legacy family from cage motors.Brush shifting reversal is a design-specific isolated adjustment.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Repulsion motor single-phase commutator AC motor છે જેમાં energised stator અને wound rotor હોય;short-circuited brushes stator magnetic axisથી displaced રાખી torque મેળવાય છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Stator main winding alternating flux બનાવે;laminated wound rotorમાં commutator છે.
  2. Shorted brush gearનો defined angular displacement હોય;alignment/protection જરૂરી છે.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Stator flux shorted brush/commutator circuitમાં rotor current induce કરે.
  2. Displaced magnetic axesનું interaction starting torque આપે;special switching હોય તો running mode બદલે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Rotor current induced છે,brushesથી સીધો supply નથી;brush-axis displacementથી starting torqueનું magnetic interaction બને છે.
  • Repulsion-induction/repulsion-start induction-run variantsનાં running circuits જુદા છે.દરેકમાં running speed પર સમાન brush action રહે એવું નકહો.
  • Brush/commutator wear,sparking/maintenance આ legacy familyને cage motorથી અલગ કરે.Brush-shift reversal design-specific isolated adjustment છે.

h.en: Universal motor:series connection and reversal

body.en:
Definition

A universal motor is a suitably designed series-wound commutator motor capable of operation on AC or DC of its specified ratings,because armature current and field polarity reverse together on AC.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Series stator field,wound armature,commutator and carbon brushes carry the operating current path.
  2. Laminated magnetic parts reduce AC eddy losses;bearings,fan and enclosure must withstand rated high speed.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Supply drives the series field/armature current;brush commutation maintains the appropriate conductor-current relationship.
  2. Electromagnetic torque accelerates the connected load;load reduction normally increases speed and requires proper speed protection/control.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Torque T∝ΦIa;when AC reverses both Φand Ia,the torque direction is retained.Lamination and compensation/commutation design limit AC losses;not every DC series motor is a universal motor.
  • High speed and high starting torque suit mixers and portable tools.No-load speed can become dangerous,so an unloaded run is not an acceptable casual test.
  • Reverse armature ORfield relative to the other when approved terminals exist;reversing supply alone reverses both and does not reverse torque.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Universal motor યોગ્ય designવાળી series-wound commutator motor છે જે specified ratings પર AC/DCથી ચાલે;ACમાં armature current તથા field polarity સાથે reverse થાય છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Series stator field,wound armature,commutator/carbon brushes operating current path બનાવે.
  2. Laminated parts AC eddy losses ઘટાડે;bearings,fan/enclosure rated high speed સહન કરે.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Supply series field/armature current વહાવે;brush commutation યોગ્ય conductor-current relation રાખે.
  2. Torque connected load accelerate કરે;load ઘટતાં speed વધે એટલે proper protection/control જોઈએ.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • T∝ΦIa;ACથી Φ/Ia બંને reverse થતાં torque direction સમાન રહે.Lamination/commutation design AC losses મર્યાદિત કરે;દરેક DC series motor universal નથી.
  • High speed/starting torque mixers/portable tools માટે ઉપયોગી.No-load speed જોખમી વધી શકે;casual unloaded test નકરવો.
  • Approved terminals હોય તો armature અથવા fieldમાંથી એકનું relative connection reverse કરો;માત્ર supply reverseથી બંને reverse થાય/torque નહીં.

title.en: 1.6 Selecting a motor for an actual appliance

h.en: Selecting a motor for an actual appliance

body.en:
Definition

Motor selection is matching the machine torque–speed capability,thermal duty,supply and mechanical/environmental ratings to the driven load over starting,running and abnormal conditions.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Fan duty emphasises quiet continuous operation and suitable speed control;a compatible permanent-capacitor design is common.A positive-displacement compressor may need substantially higher breakaway torque and approved restart delay.
  • For shaft power Pout and speed N,Trated=9550 Pout(kW)/N(rpm).This steady torque does not establish starting or overload capability;check the complete torque curve and acceleration time.
  • Check supply voltage/frequency,rotation,capacitor type,insulation/duty,IP enclosure,cooling,mounting and protection.A larger motor is not automatically more efficient at the actual load.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. A0.75 kW shaft load at1440 rpm needs about4.97N·msteady torque;starting margin and service conditions still require a separate check.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Motor selection એટલે starting,running/abnormal conditionsમાં load સાથે motorની torque–speed capability,thermal duty,supply/mechanical-environmental ratings મેળવો.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Fan માટે quiet continuous duty/યોગ્ય speed control મહત્વનાં;compatible permanent-capacitor સામાન્ય છે.Positive-displacement compressor માટે વધુ breakaway torque/approved restart delay જોઈએ.
  • Shaft power Pout/speed N માટે Trated=9550 Pout(kW)/N(rpm).આ steady torqueથી starting/overload capability નક્કી નથી થતી;full curve/acceleration time જુઓ.
  • Supply voltage/frequency,rotation,capacitor type,insulation/duty,IP,cooling,mounting/protection તપાસો.Actual load પર મોટી motor હંમેશાં વધુ efficient નથી.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. 1440 rpm પર0.75 kW shaft load માટે આશરે4.97N·m steady torque જોઈએ;starting margin/service conditions અલગ તપાસવાના.

title.en: 1.7 Maintenance and symptom-based fault finding

h.en: Maintenance and symptom-based fault finding

body.en:
Definition

Preventive maintenance is planned inspection,cleaning,condition assessment and corrective action intended to retain safe reliable operation before a functional failure occurs.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Isolate,lock out,verify absence of voltage and discharge capacitors by the approved method before inspection.Check earthing,terminal tightness,ventilation,mechanical freedom and signs of heat or rubbing.
  • Humming without acceleration may indicate failed capacitor/start branch,low voltage or a jammed load.Stop promptly;do not hand-spin an energised shaft to “help” it start.
  • Compare winding resistance,insulation and capacitance with manufacturer information and trends.Auxiliary resistance is often higher,but resistance alone does not prove winding identity.
  • Insulation tests can damage connected electronics/discharge devices;disconnect and choose the approved test voltage/procedure.Do not replace a capacitor by capacitance alone:AC duty,voltage and temperature ratings matter.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Preventive maintenance એટલે failure પહેલાં safe/reliable operation જાળવવા planned inspection,cleaning,condition assessment/corrective action.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Inspection પહેલાં isolate,lockout,voltage absence verify તથા approved capacitor discharge કરો.Earthing,terminals,ventilation,mechanical freedom/heat-rubbing signs જુઓ.
  • Humming છતાં acceleration નહીં હોય તો capacitor/start branch,low voltage/jammed load હોઈ શકે.તાત્કાલિક stop કરો;energised shaftને હાથથી push નકરો.
  • Winding resistance,insulation/capacitance manufacturer data/trends સાથે compare કરો.Auxiliary resistance ઘણીવાર વધારે,પણ માત્ર resistanceથી winding identity સાબિત નથી થતી.
  • Insulation test connected electronicsને નુકસાન કરી શકે;disconnect કરીને approved test voltage/procedure લો.Capacitorમાં માત્ર capacitance નહીં,AC duty/voltage/temperature પણ match કરો.
